title: Crash when running a build with Steam Game Recording enabled
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4-stable and 4.2.2-stable
Not reproducible in 3.x

From testing this appears to only happen with Vulkan renderers (Forward+ and Mobile).

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Linux Mint 22.1 (Xia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (RADV NAVI23) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

When running a Godot game through steam, if the Steam overlay and game recording is enabled, it will sometimes crash at startup.

This could very well be an issue with Steam or drivers.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a bare-bones project with the Forward+ or Mobile renderer and export it.
2. Add the exported Godot game as a non-steam game in Steam.
3. Enable game recording in steam settings and in the game's Steam properties.
4. Run the game from Steam a few times. It will occasionally crash after a few frames.
